items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: with Bob Wells and the Texas Playboys, we were very good friends

ctx.x: And so Chief, who had gotten in the band, also played piano and Chief sat in on piano and I contacted Hobart Banks that wouldn't come to New York City with us and when I contacted him--he used to call me Kingfish--he said I'll be waiting on you, Fish.

So we played Wichita, Kansas and I was gettng on into a little area--I worked pretty close in hand--I mentioned this a little further down--with Bob Wells and the Texas Playboys, we were very good friends--the western

swing bands--so they had turned me on to a little town in western Oklahoma, Longbell, nothing but a room, but in that big barn, those country bums would come from everywhere, and I booked there and told Hobart to meet me and so he was there--it was nothing but a stop in the road-- I don't know how he got there, on the bus or something--but the boys were always kidding me, I always was a hunter, a hunter and a fisherman, that was my weakness, and most of the time carried the shotgun along with me, and they all got…
